entry.summary:
## The Problem
Researchers and writers who work in markdown need a tool that links notes, manages a knowledge graph, and supports vim-style editing without leaving the terminal. Obsidian does this in a GUI; Ekphos brings the same workflow to a TUI with a fraction of the resource footprint.

entry.title: Phone to OBS Studio as Webcam
entry.summary:
## The Problem
USB webcams are mediocre and Wi-Fi phone-as-webcam apps add latency, re-encode video, or route through cloud services. This repo replaces that stack with a direct USB path: the phone's hardware H.264 encoder feeds OBS at ~91 ms measured latency (720p60), with no PC-side re-encoding and no network hop beyond localhost.
